title: Concurrency ownership boundary
request: Compare the two technically viable concurrency designs in visible evidence. Neither is declared correct or preferred. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly final-concurrency-a or final-concurrency-b and whose final_choice is exactly actor_ownership or lock_hierarchy. Do not use tools.

evidence.content: Evidence C-32: actor ownership partitions mutable state so each key is updated serially while unrelated keys progress independently. It reduces shared-state reasoning and can be introduced by partition, although cross-partition operations require messaging. Choice id: actor_ownership.

Evidence C-11: an explicit lock hierarchy preserves the current shared-memory model while bounded acquisition and instrumentation expose contention. It supports incremental verification and rapid rollback, although developers must maintain ordering discipline across modules. Choice id: lock_hierarchy.
